tools.name: gifts_for
tools.description: Gift IDs recorded for this name, including completed gifts.

name.description: Canonical lowercase top-level .eth name, e.g. riya.eth

tools.name: gift
tools.description: Full public details of a gift.

call.function: function gifts(uint256 id) view returns ((address sender,address token,uint256 amount,uint64 unlockAt,bool done,string name,string message))

tools.name: who_can_claim
tools.description: Current ENSv2 name owner; zero for unregistered or expired names. Does not check a gift unlock time.

name.description: Canonical lowercase top-level .eth name, e.g. riya.eth

tools.name: gift_usdc
tools.description: Escrow USDC for the current owner of a name at claim time. Sender can cancel before unlock or recover after 90 days.

name.description: Canonical lowercase top-level .eth name, e.g. riya.eth

unlock_on.description: Unlock date at midnight UTC, or ISO date-time with explicit timezone

message.description: Public message, at most 1024 UTF-8 bytes; never include secrets

call.function: function giftUsdc(string name,uint256 amount,uint64 unlockAt,string message) returns (uint256)

tools.name: gift_eth
tools.description: Escrow ETH for whoever owns the name at claim time, with sender cancellation/recovery rules.

name.description: Canonical lowercase top-level .eth name, e.g. riya.eth

unlock_on.description: Unlock date at midnight UTC, or ISO date-time with explicit timezone

message.description: Public message, at most 1024 UTF-8 bytes; never include secrets

call.function: function giftEth(string name,uint64 unlockAt,string message) payable returns (uint256)

tools.name: claim
tools.description: Claim an unlocked active gift as the current ENSv2 owner.

tools.name: cancel
tools.description: Refund an active gift as sender, before unlock or at least 90 days after unlock.
